---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or a change to an existing one
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["type:feature", "status:needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What user-facing problem are you trying to solve? **Describe
the problem first, the solution second.**

A good problem statement is a sentence a real user would say
out loud. "I want to..." or "I'm frustrated when..." or "The
team I work with can't...".

## User story

> As a **[role]**, I want to **[action]**, so that **[outcome]**.

Example: "As a project lead, I want to snooze a card until a
specific date, so that the card disappears from the active
board until I am ready to deal with it."

## Proposed solution

A sketch of how you would solve it. UI mockups, data model
changes, API surface, MCP tools — whatever is relevant.

If you have multiple options, list them and say which you
prefer and why.

## Alternatives considered

What else could solve the problem? Why is the proposed
solution better?

## Scope

- [ ] Small (one component, < 1 day of work)
- [ ] Medium (one bounded context, 1-3 days)
- [ ] Large (multiple contexts, > 3 days)
- [ ] Phase target: (Phase 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5)

## Target user

Who benefits from this feature?

- [ ] The maintainer (solo use case)
- [ ] A self-hosting individual
- [ ] A small team (2-10 people)
- [ ] A larger team (10+)
- [ ] An enterprise customer (50+)

## Related

- Feature inventory: [link to the relevant section of `docs/roadmap/00-feature-inventory.md`]
- ADR: [link to the relevant ADR, if one exists]
- Discussion: [link to a prior discussion, if one exists]
- Similar in other tools: [link or description, optional]
